Tools

Central to Arc’s mission is not only developing state-of-the-art technologies, but also making them widely available to accelerate biomedical research across the globe. At Arc’s Tools Portal, we’re sharing our growing list of computational tools developed by Arc scientists, along with supporting publications, documentation, and code.

Check back often, as we’ll be posting new tools as they are launched, and feel free to contact us at tools@arcinstitute.org with any questions.

New to Arc’s tools?

The following require no coding or setup, just open them in your browser and explore. Try Evo Designer, the Bridge RNA Design Tool, and Syngenome for semantic design.

Software & Tools

Algorithms, software, analysis pipelines, and machine learning models to extract new insights, accelerate discovery, predict biological outcomes, and visualize results.

Machine Learning Tools

Arc Virtual Cell Model: State

State is a multi-scale AI model that uniquely operates on sets of cells to capture population-level and cell-level perturbation effects using a modern transformer architecture.
Adduri et al., Cell, 2026

Tech Centers
Evo 2: DNA Foundation Model

Evo 2 is a biological foundation model capable of generative design from molecular to genome scale at single-nucleotide resolution.
Evo 2 Published March 2026, Nature
Evo 1 Published November 2024, Science

hie lab
hsu lab
SynGenome: 100 billion base pairs of AI-generated genomic sequence

SynGenome is a first-of-its-kind database consisting of synthetic DNA sequences generated by Evo, a genomic language model. Given a DNA sequence prompt, Evo will generate a DNA sequence response that continues the genomic sequence. Essentially, Evo enables "autocomplete" for the genome.

hie lab
Arc Virtual Cell Model: Stack

Stack is a foundation model that can perform in-context learning from unlabeled cells representing arbitrary conditions such as a chemical perturbation or a different donor, predicting the effect of those conditions on a target cell population without requiring data-specific fine-tuning.
Stack Preprint

Tech Centers

Biological Design Tools

Proto: A programming language for generative biology

Proto is a generative biology framework that unifies diverse AI models through a common programming language to enable multi-objective design of DNA, RNA, proteins, and their interactions from high-level, user-specified functional objectives.
Merchant, Guo, and Viggiano et al., bioRxiv, 2026

hie lab

Genome Engineering Tools

Bridge RNA Design Tool

Given 14 bp target and donor sequences and a bridge RNA scaffold, this tool will return the sequence of candidate bridge RNAs that should work with the respective bridge recombinase.
Perry et al., Nature, 2024
Perry et al., Science, 2025

hsu lab
konermann lab
Cas13d Guide Design Tool

Built from the largest Cas13d knockdown dataset to date, Arc's deep learning-powered Cas13d Guide RNA Selection Tool nominates high-efficiency guide sequences and any custom RNA sequences for knocking down your transcript of interest across human, mouse, other model organisms, and custom sequences.
Wei et al,. Cell Systems, 2023

konermann lab
hsu lab
ScreenPro2

ScreenPro2 is a tool for flexible pooled CRISPR screen analysis.

gilbert lab
iAnalyzer

iAnalyzer is an analytical pipeline designed for the robust analysis of CRISPR screens. It streamlines the processing of CRISPR screening data, facilitating tasks such as quality control, alignment, and statistical analysis to identify significant genetic perturbations.
Cell Reports, September 2024

goodarzi lab

Protein Engineering Tools

MULTI-evolve: ML-guided multi-mutant design

MULTI-evolve is a machine learning-guided end-to-end framework for engineering hyperactive multi-mutant proteins that combines neural network fitness prediction with combinatorial variant proposal and automated design of mutagenic oligos for gene synthesis.
Tran et al., Science, 2026

hsu lab
hie lab

Protein Annotation Tools

BioReason-Pro: Multimodal reasoning AI for protein function prediction

BioReason-Pro combines protein sequence embeddings with biological context to explain not just what a protein does, but why, like a knowledgeable colleague walking you through their reasoning.
Fallahpour et al., BioRxiv, 2026

goodarzi lab

Tech Centers

Bioinformatics Tools

cyto: ultra high-throughput 10X-Flex processing

cyto is an ultra-high throughput processor for 10x Flex single-cell sequencing that achieves a 16.5-fold speedup over CellRanger through direct k-mer lookup and novel binary formats (IBU and BINSEQ), making atlas-scale projects and genome-wide perturbation screens computationally feasible.
cyto Preprint

Tech Centers
BINSEQ: A Family of High-Performance Binary Formats for Nucleotide Sequences

BINSEQ is a family of simple binary formats that enable high-performance parallel processing of sequencing data.
Teyssier and Dobin, PLOS Computational Biology, 2026

Tech Centers
xsra

A performant and storage-efficient CLI tool to extract sequences from an SRA archive with support for FASTA, FASTQ, and BINSEQ outputs.
